statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let primeMass := fun x : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ (block x).filter (fun n => Nat.Prime (n^2+1)), Real.log ((n^2+1 : ℕ) : ℝ); ∀ x : ℕ, 0 < primeMass x → ∃ n ∈ block x, ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ n^2+1=p

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0070 · 从单位余因子质量提取区间内的素数值
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0070 · Extract a prime value from positive unit-cofactor mass

brief.zh: 正权和给出素数项，对应大素因子的余因子正好是 1。
brief.en: Select a positive summand. The prime divisor of that value has cofactor one.
